listings.title: APOLLO 18 SPEED CONVERTED ROAD BIKE (LARGE FRAME)
listings.seller_notes: 18-speed converted road bike; 27-inch wheels and new tires. Seller says it suits riders around 6 feet; test fit before purchase.
listings.posting_text:
APOLLO 18 SPEED CONVERTED ROAD BIKE (LARGE FRAME)
Calling all 6 footers! Finally, a bike large enough to accommodate tall riders!
The frame has some cosmetic scratches and the decals are faded (less likely to be stolen) but this converted road bike is ready for some no nonsense riding, a real delight to ride!
This light, 25” LARGE, FRAME bike is suitable for TALL sized riders  starting to enjoy the freedom of cycling. It has reliable, simple to adjust CALIPER-BRAKES, large diameter 27 INCH ALUMINUM WHEELS and NEW TIRES with lots of tread.
The smooth, 18 SPEED INDEX THUMB  SHIFTERS are mounted on the handle bar and work like a clock, the seat is comfortable and is easily adjusted for height.
CLEANED, TUNED, LUBRICATED AND READY FOR THE ROAD/TRAIL
 Respond to my ad by e-mail and I will get back to you either by text, phone or e-mail to arrange a time that is convenient for you to have a closer look and a test ride.
Ready for viewing and pick up near 20th Ave. and Knight St. in Vancouver 
$120.00 O.B.O. (NO TAX)

listings.title: Vintage North Country Mountain Bike / Commuter – Ready to Ride!
listings.seller_notes: 26-inch wheels; steel frame; seller says it was tuned up and stored indoors.
listings.posting_text:
Classic North Country mountain bike perfect for daily commuting, casual cruising, or campus riding.

This bike has been tuned up and stored indoors and is in clean, solid condition. 

It features a durable frame, classic high-rise handlebars for a comfortable upright riding position, and includes a handy water bottle cage.

Very strong metal spokes and very strong and durable. 

• Wheel Size: 26 inch
• Frame: Steel
• Brakes & Gears: Multi-speed thumb shifters and standard rim brakes
• Condition: Complete and intact, frame looks great with very minor cosmetic wear from normal use.

Great budget-friendly alternative to expensive new bikes.

Pick up by Main Street & 46th Avenue, Vancouver
